mistake_reason: At step 14, the orchestrator unexpectedly lost conversation history and proceeded as if no file analysis had occurred, ignoring FileSurfer’s earlier successful extraction of the correct title ("Time-Parking 2: Parallel Universe"). This context amnesia led the orchestrator to restart the task using generic web search for the "oldest Blu-Ray" rather than the spreadsheet-specific data, ultimately producing the wrong answer. This matches FM-1.4: Loss of Conversation History, where recent results and instructions were disregarded and the dialogue reverted to an antecedent state.
